subject: Contract playbook & Coupa enrollment: redline sprint and portal checklist
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Amit Desai <amit.desai@healthsphere.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, dev_patel@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 11 Jan 2027 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Contract playbook & Coupa enrollment: redline sprint and portal checklist

Hi Amit —

Thanks for the quick intro earlier. To keep momentum we want to share our proposed redline playbook and a short Coupa onboarding checklist so your procurement and IT teams can validate acceptance criteria. Attached: Redline_MSA_v1.pdf (high level comments) and a Coupa_Field_Map.xlsx with suggested PO/ACK fields we expect to map.

Quick asks for HealthSphere:
- Confirm any mandatory vendor fields in your Coupa instance (tax id, remit address, GL code mapping) by EOD Wed 1/13
- Share the vendor enrollment form if you have one (we can pre-populate to speed registration)
- Point of contact for EDI/SFTP if you require PO routing to our systems

If helpful we can run a 30-min playbook walkthrough — available Tue/12 10:00-11:00 PST or Wed/13 14:00-15:00 PST.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Head, Procurement Ops — Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: Redline_MSA_v1.pdf (14 pages, annotated), Coupa_Field_Map.xlsx

From: Amit Desai <amit.desai@healthsphere.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: procure-team@healthsphere.com, legal@healthsphere.com
Date: Mon, 11 Jan 2027 11:04:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Contract playbook & Coupa enrollment: redline sprint and portal checklist

Kimberly —

Appreciate the materials. Attaching our vendor enrollment form (HealthSphere_Vendor_Form.docx). A few notes from procurement:
- Mandatory fields: W-9 or equivalent (tax id), remit address, primary contact name/email, vendor classification (service/product)
- Our Coupa instance currently requires supplier to accept PO acknowledgement within 48 hours by default
- For EDI, please provide test SFTP creds; we have a separate onboarding window for EDI partners that we can sync on

We can join Tue/12 10:00 PST if that still works — Amit + one engineer from our integrator team will attend.

— Amit Desai
Sr. Manager, Procurement | HealthSphere
amit.desai@healthsphere.com

Attachments: HealthSphere_Vendor_Form.docx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 12 Jan 2027 06:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Contract playbook & Coupa enrollment: redline sprint and portal checklist

Kim / Dev —

Thanks for loop-in. Action items from our side (I'll own the legal redline coordination):
1) Legal will consolidate MSA comments into a single redline doc and surface any non-negotiables (we expect to flag data residency, indemnity caps, and SLA language) — deliverable by EOD Wed 1/13.
2) Dev: please review Coupa_Field_Map.xlsx and confirm which PO fields we can auto-populate from our invoice flow (esp. PO number, line-level item codes, and GL mapping).
3) Ops: I'll draft a short mutual action plan (MAP) and share a HubSpot-linked checklist for tracking (target: complete vendor registration + Coupa activation by 1/21).

Also adding a note: If HealthSphere requires specific contract language around audit logs / telemetry retention we should flag that to infra early — that can affect signing cadence.

Marissa Cole
Sr. Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Subject: Re: Contract playbook & Coupa enrollment: redline sprint and portal checklist

All —

Great progress. Quick status update after the Tue meeting with Amit: HealthSphere confirmed mandatory fields and their legal team flagged three clauses for discussion — liability cap, data processing annex, and SOC-2 evidence scope. Marissa, please prioritize the liability + DPA language in the redline.

Operational next steps (for the MAP):
- Marissa: consolidated redline (EOD today 1/13) -> upload to shared Drive folder and add comments for Amit/legal to review
- Dev: prepare a short mapping doc for EDI test creds and confirm any additional attributes needed for PO ACKs (target Thu 1/14)
- Kimberly: after redline sign-off, ops to initiate Coupa supplier invite and pre-populate fields from HealthSphere_Vendor_Form.docx

Link to shared folder and MAP: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0A1B2C3D-kim-coupa-onboarding
HubSpot MAP (internal): https://app.hubspot.com/deal/1234567/HS-2027-0421

If legal needs a short exec summary to expedite internal review for HealthSphere, we can produce one-pager by tomorrow morning.

Thanks,
Grace O'Connor
Director, Customer Success — Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0147
